steps.what: Select and verify specialized materials for outside reading assignments
Compile bibliographies and check citation details and student access

tasks.design: Configure the {OTHER} reference manager to import selected catalogue records and format the bibliography in {DOCS}. Keep selection, source verification and student-access checks; no model invents titles or assesses clinical relevance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Citation details may be copied and formatted manually after readings are selected.
tasks.enabler_now: Reference managers can format and deduplicate verified publication records.
tasks.still_hard: Correct metadata does not guarantee an appropriate or accessible reading.
tasks.human_edge: Select material suited to the teaching purpose and students.

evidence.claim: Reference-manager import and formatting can reduce repeated citation entry; the estimate is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is this assignment's reading selection and bibliography, excluding general professional updating and student reading.

Instructor produces selected publication identifiers and versions during fully retained s1. Library catalogue supplies existing bibliographic metadata; missing identifiers or metadata require manual correction within s2's12 retained hours.
Instructor selects citation style and checks title, authors, year, edition and access in s2; no complete pre-curated bibliography is assumed.
Test native reference-manager import first; existing catalogue runtime earns no saving.
research_questions: Does native import reduce bibliography preparation after metadata and student-access checks?

already_counted.description: Correct metadata and check the final bibliography

incremental.description: Maintain citation settings and resolve import issues

approvals.approved_version: Exact selected publication versions, citation metadata, style and access links; changes require renewed review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R72 gross28 minus3 upkeep =25 net E1. High needs manual citation formatting; low covers existing reference-manager use or incomplete catalogue metadata.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events

steps.what: Participate in campus and community events and engage with attendees

tasks.design: Retain personal event participation. Existing event information in {CALENDAR} supports attendance, with no event-planning workload assumed within this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Participation depends on presence and interaction.
tasks.still_hard: Responding usefully to different participants and interests.
tasks.human_edge: Represent the program and form community relationships.

reach.task: Connect community participants and the institution

evidence.claim: Personal event participation is retained with no saving.

assumptions: Boundary is participation, excluding organiser preparation and scheduling.
Organiser provides existing event details; instructor engagement remains fully counted without new capture.
No system change or recurring upkeep.
unknowns: Event types and expected instructor contribution
research_questions: What contribution do participants need from the instructor at each event?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; personal attendance and interaction remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise student teaching, internships and research

steps.what: Observe and review undergraduate or graduate teaching, internship and research work
Supervise student work through feedback, guidance and escalation when needed

tasks.design: Retain direct observation and supervision, using existing student work in {DOCS}. No automated performance judgement substitutes for practical or research supervision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision requires context and feedback on the actual work.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing access to student work supports the unchanged task.
tasks.still_hard: Judging when to intervene and what guidance the student needs.
tasks.human_edge: Observe, challenge reasoning and support safe development.

evidence.claim: Observation and supervision remain human work with no proposed labour reduction.

assumptions: Boundary is supervision and developmental feedback, excluding separately counted formal grading and record transfer.
Instructor produces observations in s1; student supplies their perspective in s2. No structured competence score is assumed.
No new software or incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which supervision concerns require a placement or program lead's involvement?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; contextual observation and guidance remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Conduct research in a defined field using appropriate methods
Interpret findings and write the research contribution with its limitations
Review and submit findings for publication in professional journals, books or electronic media

tasks.design: Retain research conduct, interpretation and accountable writing in {DOCS} and the existing {DATA_PLATFORM}. Submission uses the {OTHER} publisher submission portal; no generic model analysis is introduced without a defined research method.
tasks.previous_blocker: Research methods and outputs vary too much to infer a common automation opportunity.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing research tools support the unchanged work.
tasks.still_hard: Establishing a valid contribution and stating limitations honestly.
tasks.human_edge: Choose sound methods, interpret evidence and take responsibility for claims.
tasks.altitude: Research and publication responsibilities remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: The broad research task does not establish a repeatable analysis or writing subtask with a supported saving; the design retains all effort.

assumptions: Boundary is instructor research and publication effort, excluding participants, coauthors, reviewers and publisher work.
Researcher produces and verifies evidence according to the existing protocol within s1. No clean structured dataset, validated codebook or complete source pack is assumed.
Writing in s2 includes interpretation and evidential reasoning; it is not treated as transcription. Existing software runtime earns no saving.
Native research and submission tools remain unchanged; additional upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Research methods, evidence type and publication workload
research_questions: Which specific research operation is repetitive enough to test separately without changing the method?

already_counted.description: Research conduct, interpretation, writing and submission

approvals.approved_version: Exact manuscript, results, claims, limitations and publication destination; edits require renewed author review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; no defined repeatable research operation is changed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce bibliography formatting where manual work exists; retain supervision, community participation and research judgement.
reach: Coordinate reading access with librarians and learning support with clinical supervisors
role.ambitious_version: An instructor with less citation-formatting work and unchanged responsibility for students and research.
